verdict.rationale: Gecko offers event-driven building blocks rather than a general rule engine. Webhooks push scan and finding events to your systems, for example to page a channel when a scan fails or open a workflow when a critical lands (docs-24, docs-10). PR checks have a configurable fail-on-severity threshold (docs-29), and Gecko automatically rechecks findings when a fix merges (docs-16). Missing for 10: a native user-defined rule/condition-action engine inside Gecko, configurable automatic actions beyond the severity gate (acting on webhooks requires external tooling), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
